In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

### **What is the difference between CPB Medical Billing course and the CPC Preparation course? **

The [CPC Preparation course][184] teaches physician office coding, such as how to assign the proper
diagnosis and procedure codes from operative reports and patient charts. This course also helps to
prepare you for the CPC certification exam. The [CPB Medical Billing][185] course emphasizes billing
and only lightly touches on coding, and will prepare you for the CPB certification exam. This course
teaches medical billing and reimbursement issues, such as how to take the codes that have already
been assigned by the coder and process a claim form, and how to work with 3rd party payers to make
sure the claim is processed correctly. It is important that a coder understands billing issues as it
helps to decrease claim denials and increase reimbursement. An understanding of billing will also
expand a coder’s career opportunities.

Founder | Board Certified Facial Plastic Surgeon

### Christina Magill, MD, FACS

Dr. Magill, a board-certified facial plastic surgeon and board-certified in otolaryngology-head and
neck surgery, offers a comprehensive suite of facial plastic surgeries to enhance and rejuvenate the
appearance of the face and neck. Our surgical techniques address a wide range of cosmetic concerns,
from facial asymmetry and signs of aging to congenital abnormalities and traumatic injuries. Whether
it’s a facelift, rhinoplasty, [cleft lip palate][162], eyelid surgery, or chin augmentation, we help
you achieve natural-looking results that boost your confidence and elevate your innate beauty.

[VIEW MORE ABOUT DR. MAGILL][163]

Board Certified, Otolaryngology- Head and Neck Surgery

### E. Ritter Sansoni, MD

Dr. E. Ritter Sansoni is a double fellowship-trained otolaryngologist, certified by the board, with
expertise in head and neck surgery, advanced rhinology, and skull base surgery. He earned his
medical degree from the Medical University of South Carolina, then pursued his internship and
residency at Oregon Health and Science University, specializing in otolaryngology – head and neck
surgery.

## Who We Are

*“We believe that everyone should have a chance to hear and connect with others. However, some are
not blessed with this gift, and we plan to help them.”*

Our Audiologist specializes in adult hearing care. We are committed to servicing the Carlyle
community. If you are having trouble hearing and it is becoming difficult to hear conversations with
family and friends, then it may be time to come see what we have to offer.

[More About Us][44]

## Our Services

### Evaluations

An evaluation begins by discussing your concerns with hearing loss and your current lifestyle. The
assessment begins with the Video Otoscope, where together we can visualize your eardrum and ear
canal. When necessary, earwax removal can also be performed. Tympanometry will assess the status of
the middle ear by putting a small amount of pressure into the ear canal and recording eardrum
movement.

### Testings

The hearing evaluation is then completed in a state-of-the-art sound booth with a diagnostic
audiometer. After determining the type and severity of your hearing loss, and discussing your
individual lifestyle needs, we will recommend treatment accordingly. These tests will determine
whether your hearing loss is best treated medically, with hearing aids, tinnitus devices, or an
Assistive Listening Devices.

[View All Services][45]

## Our Products

A variety of advanced hearing products are available. Traditional aids range from CIC instruments,
(Completely In Canal), ITC (In The Canal), Full Shell, RIC (Receiver In Canal) and BTE (Behind The
Ear). We will work with you to determine the best solution for your lifestyle and work with most
manufacturers to ensure the right fit. We also offer a full range of prices so that everyone can
afford to hear again.

[View Our Products][46]

## Ongoing Support

After the fitting of your hearing aids we recommend three or four follow up visits. During these
follow up evaluations we will ensure that the prescription chosen is the right one for you and will
work through fine tunings and specific changes in the programming and manipulation of the hearing
instruments.

We will take time for you to fully understand how to use and take care of your new hearing devices.
During these visits, we’ll ask you how your hearing aids are performing in the environments that are
most important to you, and will adjust the programming to help you hear better in those situations.

## Отзывы

Насколько же меняется качество жизни ребенка, как только он начинает дышать носом. Никто не
задумывается о том насколько это важно, пока какая-нибудь болезнь не лишает нас этого, особенно
адекватное дыхание важно для детей! Наша маленькая Ангелина не даст соврать. Сегодня выписали ее
домой. Вылечили атрезию хоан, теперь дышим носом на все 100%!
Атрезия хоан хоть и редкая патология, но к нам сейчас обращается очень много деток с этой проблемой
со всей страны. Перед вами наш героический парень, Альпер, ему всего 10 месяцев. Вместе с родителями
радуемся тому, как ребенок дышит после реконструкции хоан нашим «фирменным» способом без трубок и
прочих девайсов. После операции прошел месяц, дышим отлично! 
С моей счастливой пациенткой и будущей коллегой Олей! Самая большая благодарность — это вот такая
счастливая улыбка ребенка и ее родителей, после лечения всего неделя прошла, а уже море
положительных эмоций и свободное дыхание. Особенно радует, что после посещения отделения у ребенка
не то, что не осталось негативных воспоминаний, а ребенок твердо решил стать оториноларингологом!
«
Малышу всего 20 дней, ребенок с рождения не может дышать носом из-за рубцового стеноза носовых
ходов, из-за этого ребенок не может ни есть, ни спать, теряет вес и испытывает колоссальные
трудности, что конечно сказывается и на состоянии родителей. Мы рассекли рубцы всей полости носа,
реконструировали носовые раковины и перегородку носа, установили силиконовые протекторы, и скоро наш
маленький герой должен задышать полной грудью!
У нашего маленького пациента Максима было выраженное снижение слуха, отстаивание в речевом развитии,
шепотную речь ребенок почти не слышит, а разговорную разбирает с трудом. Мы удалили ему аденоиды,
освободив устье слуховой трубы, частично удалили миндалины и выполнили эндоскопическое шунтирование
барабанных полостей. Вскоре все наладится, он будет дышать и слышать нормально. А главное, что
малышу не было ни секунды больно, это один из важнейших аспектов педиатрической медицины — не
причинять боль детям
«

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

## Welcome to
## Hearing Evaluation Services of Buffalo

Hearing well empowers and enriches our everyday lives. It allows us to be social, be productive in
our work, and keep our brains healthy. As a non-profit organization, our priorities are directly
centered around our patient’s health. We provide comprehensive and diagnostic [**hearing**][99],
[**tinnitus**][100], and [**balance services **][101]to the people of Buffalo and the surrounding
communities.

balance issues, know that you have options and that together we can improve your life through
personal and honest hearing healthcare.

## Hearing Care

Our center provides comprehensive hearing care services, including; complete hearing evaluations,
hearing loss rehabilitation, education, and counseling. Our goal is to improve the lives of people
with hearing loss through better hearing and quality hearing care services.

In order to meet your individual hearing needs, we may refer you for medical treatment if indicated,
or recommend hearing aids, or other assistive listening devices. We dispense a wide range of hearing
technology including the latest models to suit most every hearing loss, hearing need, unique
lifestyle, and budget.

  Therapy and management for various conditions of “ringing in the ears.”

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

## NeuroHear Vitality Plan

### Treating Hearing as an Ongoing Lifestyle System, Not a One-Time Diagnosis

[img]

#### Precision Testing For Hearing & Brain Health

We don’t only run a hearing test, we assess how your brain processes sound, focus and conversation
in everyday situations. By combining advanced technology with trusted cognitive methods, we can
provide a clearer picture of your cognitive-auditory health.

[img]

#### Tinnitus Relief to Focus & Calm

Our evidence-based treatments help reduce the ringing in your ears and quiet your mind – so you can
think clearer and feel more at ease.

[img]

#### Next-Gen Hearing Treatments That Keep You Sharp

Sound is how your brain stays in the game. We are not just managing hearing loss with hearing aids,
we’re enrolling you into a long-term hearing optimization program designed to support your function,
independence, and cognitive health.

compassionate approach to cancer treatment. Founded by Dr. Ch. Mohana Vamsy, Chief Surgical

across the region.

departments, including medical oncology, surgical oncology, and radiation oncology. Whether you are
looking for a cancer care clinic & hospital or seeking advanced treatments at a leading cancer
hospital in Vizag, Omega Hospitals is your destination for excellence.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

## Meet Our Hearing Specialist

Alayna Rule, our registered hearing specialist, has been working in the field for several years. As
a recent graduate from Western University and Conestoga College, she offers a diverse perspective on
hearing health. As an active member of the Association of Hearing Instrument Practitioners, she
maintains a credited amount of continuing education units each year. We recognize that this field is
continuously changing, staying up-to-date on the latest products, services, and equipment is
essential in providing individuals with the best quality of care.

[Learn More][29]

[Alayna Rule]

### Alayna Rule, HIS

#### Hearing Instrument Specialist

[View Profile][30]

## Comprehensive Hearing Care

At the Rule Hearing Centre in Chatham, we are committed to providing every patient the treatment and
technology needed to improve their overall hearing health care. We provide hearing aids, custom ear
protection and hearing evaluations. We are proud members of the Association of Hearing Instrument
Practitioners. Call us today to schedule a free hearing evaluation!

[Explore Our Services][31]

## Educating You on Your Hearing Loss Solutions

In a comfortable professional setting, Rule Hearing Centre educates patients on their hearing loss
and all available options. We understand that changes in hearing due to aging or noise exposure can
emerge as early as 50 years old. It is our job to address an individual’s hearing loss and offer
affordable solutions. We stand by our products and exceptional services, including full 3 year
warranties on all hearing aids, 3 year battery supply, and 3 year office treatment plans.

[Learn More][32]

## Visit Rule Hearing Centre in Chatham

We are located at 735 St. Clair Street inside The Anjema Eye Institute building. Free Wi-Fi and
parking are available. Our centre is also completely wheelchair accessible. Additionally, there is a
route stop for C-K transit not far from our location.

Have a question for our hearing care specialist? Would you like more information on the hearing
products and services we offer?

## Hearing Care is Health Care

As Audiologists, we believe that hearing care is fundamental to overall health care. Since 1991, our
goal has been to integrate the unique needs of each patient with the expertise of our Audiologists
to provide hearing solutions for our changing world. 

It’s not only about hearing; it’s about interpersonal communication, your relationships, your
well-being -  and so much more as healthy hearing connects us to our world.

[ Meet Our Team ][63]
* ## Adult Hearing Evaluations
  
  An audiological evaluation gives you information about why you may have difficulty hearing in
  meetings, at happy hour, or while watching TV.
  
  [ Learn More ][64]
* ## Balance and Vestibular Testing
  
  If you notice slight dizziness or the feeling of being off balance with movement, this testing
  will provide you with information as to the root cause of your symptoms.
  
  [ Learn More ][65]
* ## Hearing Aid Fittings
  
  These appointments are designed for prescriptive hearing aid fittings. Hearing aids at our office
  are all custom fit to each patients’ specific needs.
  
  [ Learn More ][66]
* ## Pediatric Hearing Evaluations
  
  These evaluations answer questions of speech delay, school concerns, and middle-ear infections.
  Results provide guidance for therapy, referral for medical treatment, or relief that all is well.
  
  [ Learn More ][67]
* ## Tinnitus Rehabilitation
  
  If you have ringing in your ears, this appointment is designed to evaluate the cause of your
  tinnitus and determine which type of treatment would most benefit you.
  
  [ Learn More ][68]

# The Warner Tech-care Difference

Our Mission is to positively impact the lives of those with hearing loss by promoting prevention and
providing lasting hearing solutions. We work toward this each day by creating an impactful customer
experience through the following three key values:

#### Unmatched Service

We have over 140 combined years of experience in the hearing health industry. Our priority is going
above and beyond the needs and expectations of our customers each and every day.

[Learn More][166]

#### Valued Partnerships

We've built our business on integrity and loyalty which has been the foundation for long lasting
relationships since day one. Our partners have confidence that we will always be there to support
them, even when it matters most.

[Learn More][167]

#### Product Support

Our product breadth exceeds the industry standard with over 4200 products ranging from clinical to
manufacturing supplies. We offer the most comprehensive product catalog both online and in print
with all the information you need.

[Learn More][168]

### **What is the difference between CPB Medical Billing course and the CPC Preparation course? **

The [CPC Preparation course][184] teaches physician office coding, such as how to assign the proper
diagnosis and procedure codes from operative reports and patient charts. This course also helps to
prepare you for the CPC certification exam. The [CPB Medical Billing][185] course emphasizes billing
and only lightly touches on coding, and will prepare you for the CPB certification exam. This course
teaches medical billing and reimbursement issues, such as how to take the codes that have already
been assigned by the coder and process a claim form, and how to work with 3rd party payers to make
sure the claim is processed correctly. It is important that a coder understands billing issues as it
helps to decrease claim denials and increase reimbursement. An understanding of billing will also
expand a coder’s career opportunities.

Founder | Board Certified Facial Plastic Surgeon

### Christina Magill, MD, FACS

Dr. Magill, a board-certified facial plastic surgeon and board-certified in otolaryngology-head and
neck surgery, offers a comprehensive suite of facial plastic surgeries to enhance and rejuvenate the
appearance of the face and neck. Our surgical techniques address a wide range of cosmetic concerns,
from facial asymmetry and signs of aging to congenital abnormalities and traumatic injuries. Whether
it’s a facelift, rhinoplasty, [cleft lip palate][162], eyelid surgery, or chin augmentation, we help
you achieve natural-looking results that boost your confidence and elevate your innate beauty.

Board Certified, Otolaryngology- Head and Neck Surgery

### E. Ritter Sansoni, MD

Dr. E. Ritter Sansoni is a double fellowship-trained otolaryngologist, certified by the board, with
expertise in head and neck surgery, advanced rhinology, and skull base surgery. He earned his
medical degree from the Medical University of South Carolina, then pursued his internship and
residency at Oregon Health and Science University, specializing in otolaryngology – head and neck
surgery.

## Who We Are

*“We believe that everyone should have a chance to hear and connect with others. However, some are
not blessed with this gift, and we plan to help them.”*

Our Audiologist specializes in adult hearing care. We are committed to servicing the Carlyle
community. If you are having trouble hearing and it is becoming difficult to hear conversations with
family and friends, then it may be time to come see what we have to offer.

[More About Us][44]

## Our Services

### Evaluations

An evaluation begins by discussing your concerns with hearing loss and your current lifestyle. The
assessment begins with the Video Otoscope, where together we can visualize your eardrum and ear
canal. When necessary, earwax removal can also be performed. Tympanometry will assess the status of
the middle ear by putting a small amount of pressure into the ear canal and recording eardrum
movement.

### Testings

The hearing evaluation is then completed in a state-of-the-art sound booth with a diagnostic
audiometer. After determining the type and severity of your hearing loss, and discussing your
individual lifestyle needs, we will recommend treatment accordingly. These tests will determine
whether your hearing loss is best treated medically, with hearing aids, tinnitus devices, or an
Assistive Listening Devices.

[View All Services][45]

## Our Products

A variety of advanced hearing products are available. Traditional aids range from CIC instruments,
(Completely In Canal), ITC (In The Canal), Full Shell, RIC (Receiver In Canal) and BTE (Behind The
Ear). We will work with you to determine the best solution for your lifestyle and work with most
manufacturers to ensure the right fit. We also offer a full range of prices so that everyone can
afford to hear again.

[View Our Products][46]

## Ongoing Support

After the fitting of your hearing aids we recommend three or four follow up visits. During these
follow up evaluations we will ensure that the prescription chosen is the right one for you and will
work through fine tunings and specific changes in the programming and manipulation of the hearing
instruments.

We will take time for you to fully understand how to use and take care of your new hearing devices.
During these visits, we’ll ask you how your hearing aids are performing in the environments that are
most important to you, and will adjust the programming to help you hear better in those situations.

## Отзывы

Насколько же меняется качество жизни ребенка, как только он начинает дышать носом. Никто не
задумывается о том насколько это важно, пока какая-нибудь болезнь не лишает нас этого, особенно
адекватное дыхание важно для детей! Наша маленькая Ангелина не даст соврать. Сегодня выписали ее
домой. Вылечили атрезию хоан, теперь дышим носом на все 100%!
Атрезия хоан хоть и редкая патология, но к нам сейчас обращается очень много деток с этой проблемой
со всей страны. Перед вами наш героический парень, Альпер, ему всего 10 месяцев. Вместе с родителями
радуемся тому, как ребенок дышит после реконструкции хоан нашим «фирменным» способом без трубок и
прочих девайсов. После операции прошел месяц, дышим отлично! 
С моей счастливой пациенткой и будущей коллегой Олей! Самая большая благодарность — это вот такая
счастливая улыбка ребенка и ее родителей, после лечения всего неделя прошла, а уже море
положительных эмоций и свободное дыхание. Особенно радует, что после посещения отделения у ребенка
не то, что не осталось негативных воспоминаний, а ребенок твердо решил стать оториноларингологом!
«
Малышу всего 20 дней, ребенок с рождения не может дышать носом из-за рубцового стеноза носовых
ходов, из-за этого ребенок не может ни есть, ни спать, теряет вес и испытывает колоссальные
трудности, что конечно сказывается и на состоянии родителей. Мы рассекли рубцы всей полости носа,
реконструировали носовые раковины и перегородку носа, установили силиконовые протекторы, и скоро наш
маленький герой должен задышать полной грудью!
У нашего маленького пациента Максима было выраженное снижение слуха, отстаивание в речевом развитии,
шепотную речь ребенок почти не слышит, а разговорную разбирает с трудом. Мы удалили ему аденоиды,
освободив устье слуховой трубы, частично удалили миндалины и выполнили эндоскопическое шунтирование
барабанных полостей. Вскоре все наладится, он будет дышать и слышать нормально. А главное, что
малышу не было ни секунды больно, это один из важнейших аспектов педиатрической медицины — не
причинять боль детям
«

Пластика атрезии хоан
Реабилитация 1 день вместо 6 месяцев.
Без рецидивов. Без трубок и протекторов.
При рождении мы не умеем дышать ртом, только носом, и только к году появляется навык ротового
дыхания. Атрезия хоан – редкая патология, рожденные с ней дети не могут полноценно дышать, кушать и
спать, что замедляет их развитие и может быть даже опасно для жизни. Атрезия хоан еще недавно
требовала очень травматичной операции с ношением жутких трубок и протекторов в носу на 6-8 месяцев.

Мы разработали методику, которая позволяет сократить период реабилитации до нескольких дней, без
трубок и протекторов, при этом с самого рождения.

## Отзывы

Насколько же меняется качество жизни ребенка, как только он начинает дышать носом. Никто не
задумывается о том насколько это важно, пока какая-нибудь болезнь не лишает нас этого, особенно
адекватное дыхание важно для детей! Наша маленькая Ангелина не даст соврать. Сегодня выписали ее
домой. Вылечили атрезию хоан, теперь дышим носом на все 100%!
Атрезия хоан хоть и редкая патология, но к нам сейчас обращается очень много деток с этой проблемой
со всей страны. Перед вами наш героический парень, Альпер, ему всего 10 месяцев. Вместе с родителями
радуемся тому, как ребенок дышит после реконструкции хоан нашим «фирменным» способом без трубок и
прочих девайсов. После операции прошел месяц, дышим отлично! 
С моей счастливой пациенткой и будущей коллегой Олей! Самая большая благодарность — это вот такая
счастливая улыбка ребенка и ее родителей, после лечения всего неделя прошла, а уже море
положительных эмоций и свободное дыхание. Особенно радует, что после посещения отделения у ребенка
не то, что не осталось негативных воспоминаний, а ребенок твердо решил стать оториноларингологом!
«
Малышу всего 20 дней, ребенок с рождения не может дышать носом из-за рубцового стеноза носовых
ходов, из-за этого ребенок не может ни есть, ни спать, теряет вес и испытывает колоссальные
трудности, что конечно сказывается и на состоянии родителей. Мы рассекли рубцы всей полости носа,
реконструировали носовые раковины и перегородку носа, установили силиконовые протекторы, и скоро наш
маленький герой должен задышать полной грудью!
У нашего маленького пациента Максима было выраженное снижение слуха, отстаивание в речевом развитии,
шепотную речь ребенок почти не слышит, а разговорную разбирает с трудом. Мы удалили ему аденоиды,
освободив устье слуховой трубы, частично удалили миндалины и выполнили эндоскопическое шунтирование
барабанных полостей. Вскоре все наладится, он будет дышать и слышать нормально. А главное, что
малышу не было ни секунды больно, это один из важнейших аспектов педиатрической медицины — не
причинять боль детям
«

# Orlando’s Leading ENT & Sinus Care Center

## Looking for advanced skincare and aesthetics?

Dr. Boger also offers treatments through Revive Skincare. Discover more today.

[Explore Revive Skincare][13]

Trusted by Orlando Families for Over 20 Years

At the Ear Nose Throat & Sinus Center of Orlando, we specialize in providing personalized care for
patients dealing with sinus issues, allergies, hearing loss, and more. Led by Dr. Gregory Boger, our
team combines decades of experience with the latest treatments to deliver expert ENT care in a
welcoming environment. With locations in Orlando and Winter Park, we’re committed to helping you
breathe easier, hear better, and feel your best.

[Meet Dr. Boger & Team][14]

## Services We Provide

## Sinus & Nasal Care

Relief for sinus pressure, nasal blockages, and breathing issues — with medical and surgical
treatment options.

## Allergy Treatment

Testing and treatment for seasonal and year-round allergies, including immunotherapy.

## Ear & Hearing Health

Care for ear infections, hearing loss, tinnitus, and balance issues in kids and adults.

## Throat & Voice Disorders

Evaluation and treatment for sore throats, hoarseness, swallowing issues, and sleep apnea.

##  Pediatric ENT

Specialized ENT care for children, from ear infections to speech-impacting hearing issues.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about

care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.

certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

## Hearing Evaluation Services of Buffalo

Hearing well empowers and enriches our everyday lives. It allows us to be social, be productive in
our work, and keep our brains healthy. As a non-profit organization, our priorities are directly
centered around our patient’s health. We provide comprehensive and diagnostic [**hearing**][99],
[**tinnitus**][100], and [**balance services **][101]to the people of Buffalo and the surrounding
communities.

If you suspect you could be hearing better than you currently are, or are experiencing tinnitus or
balance issues, know that you have options and that together we can improve your life through
personal and honest hearing healthcare.

Better hearing health is possible, [**contact us**][102]** today**!

## Hearing Care

Our center provides comprehensive hearing care services, including; complete hearing evaluations,
hearing loss rehabilitation, education, and counseling. Our goal is to improve the lives of people
with hearing loss through better hearing and quality hearing care services.

In order to meet your individual hearing needs, we may refer you for medical treatment if indicated,
or recommend hearing aids, or other assistive listening devices. We dispense a wide range of hearing
technology including the latest models to suit most every hearing loss, hearing need, unique
lifestyle, and budget.

[SERVICES][47]

[earplugs]

  A great selection of products and accessories to suit your hearing loss needs.
* #### Hearing Protection
  
  Custom earmolds and earplugs for swimmers, hunters, musicians and much more.
* #### Hearing Tests
  
  Evaluations to properly diagnose and treat your particular type of hearing loss.
* #### Tinnitus
  
  Therapy and management for various conditions of “ringing in the ears.”

THE LATEST TECHNOLOGY

## Hearing Products

Hearing protection and hearing loss prevention are key components of our care. Through consultation
on the effects of noise on hearing, community outreach talks, screenings, and the dispensing of
hearing protection devices, we strive to educate our patients and the general public on the
importance of hearing and how to protect it.

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and

  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and

  ][53]

  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn

  ][54]

  ][55]

  ][56]

  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]

  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]

  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]

  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.

## Meet Our Hearing Specialist

Alayna Rule, our registered hearing specialist, has been working in the field for several years. As
a recent graduate from Western University and Conestoga College, she offers a diverse perspective on
hearing health. As an active member of the Association of Hearing Instrument Practitioners, she
maintains a credited amount of continuing education units each year. We recognize that this field is
continuously changing, staying up-to-date on the latest products, services, and equipment is
essential in providing individuals with the best quality of care.

## Comprehensive Hearing Care

At the Rule Hearing Centre in Chatham, we are committed to providing every patient the treatment and
technology needed to improve their overall hearing health care. We provide hearing aids, custom ear
protection and hearing evaluations. We are proud members of the Association of Hearing Instrument
Practitioners. Call us today to schedule a free hearing evaluation!

[Explore Our Services][31]

## Educating You on Your Hearing Loss Solutions

In a comfortable professional setting, Rule Hearing Centre educates patients on their hearing loss
and all available options. We understand that changes in hearing due to aging or noise exposure can
emerge as early as 50 years old. It is our job to address an individual’s hearing loss and offer
affordable solutions. We stand by our products and exceptional services, including full 3 year
warranties on all hearing aids, 3 year battery supply, and 3 year office treatment plans.

[Learn More][32]

## Visit Rule Hearing Centre in Chatham

We are located at 735 St. Clair Street inside The Anjema Eye Institute building. Free Wi-Fi and
parking are available. Our centre is also completely wheelchair accessible. Additionally, there is a
route stop for C-K transit not far from our location.

Have a question for our hearing care specialist? Would you like more information on the hearing
products and services we offer?

## Hearing Care is Health Care

As Audiologists, we believe that hearing care is fundamental to overall health care. Since 1991, our
goal has been to integrate the unique needs of each patient with the expertise of our Audiologists
to provide hearing solutions for our changing world. 

It’s not only about hearing; it’s about interpersonal communication, your relationships, your
well-being -  and so much more as healthy hearing connects us to our world.

[ Meet Our Team ][63]
* ## Adult Hearing Evaluations
  
  An audiological evaluation gives you information about why you may have difficulty hearing in
  meetings, at happy hour, or while watching TV.
  
  [ Learn More ][64]
* ## Balance and Vestibular Testing
  
  If you notice slight dizziness or the feeling of being off balance with movement, this testing
  will provide you with information as to the root cause of your symptoms.
  
  [ Learn More ][65]
* ## Hearing Aid Fittings
  
  These appointments are designed for prescriptive hearing aid fittings. Hearing aids at our office
  are all custom fit to each patients’ specific needs.
  
  [ Learn More ][66]
* ## Pediatric Hearing Evaluations
  
  These evaluations answer questions of speech delay, school concerns, and middle-ear infections.
  Results provide guidance for therapy, referral for medical treatment, or relief that all is well.
  
  [ Learn More ][67]
* ## Tinnitus Rehabilitation
  
  If you have ringing in your ears, this appointment is designed to evaluate the cause of your
  tinnitus and determine which type of treatment would most benefit you.
  
  [ Learn More ][68]

VET EXPERT brand represents professional products that support your pet by maintaining its vitality
as long as possible.

clinical tests. The formulations of products are developed by leading experts in pet nutrition with
outstanding clinical and academic experience.

VET EXPERT brand has been present on the market for over 16 years. There have been many worldwide
innovations introduced to the veterinary universe since then. Moreover, VET EXPERT products has been
numerously acknowledged and awarded.

## We are number 1*

VET EXPERT product portfolio includes supplements, veterinary diets, rapid diagnostics tests,
maintenance pet food and cosmetic & care line.

High quality and efficiency of our products have been repeatedly noticed and awarded. Product
compositions are designed in cooperation with veterinary doctors and scientists.

# The Warner Tech-care Difference

Our Mission is to positively impact the lives of those with hearing loss by promoting prevention and
providing lasting hearing solutions. We work toward this each day by creating an impactful customer
experience through the following three key values:

#### Unmatched Service

We have over 140 combined years of experience in the hearing health industry. Our priority is going
above and beyond the needs and expectations of our customers each and every day.

[Learn More][166]

#### Valued Partnerships

We've built our business on integrity and loyalty which has been the foundation for long lasting
relationships since day one. Our partners have confidence that we will always be there to support
them, even when it matters most.

[Learn More][167]

#### Product Support

Our product breadth exceeds the industry standard with over 4200 products ranging from clinical to
manufacturing supplies. We offer the most comprehensive product catalog both online and in print
with all the information you need.

[Learn More][168]
